info.name: EverCut - Authentication
info.description: OTP authentication endpoints for customer, barber, and admin test users. Sends OTP, verifies it, and captures onboarding tokens for brand-new users or JWT access/refresh tokens for returning users. Requires msg91.testMode set to true in config/index.js for local development.

variable.description: API prefix used by every request

request.description: Send an OTP to the customer test number configured in the active Postman environment.

exec: pm.test('response uses the standard envelope', function () {
if (obj && typeof obj === 'object' && obj.id !== undefined && obj.id !== null) {
pm.expect(obj.id, 'Resource id must be a string').to.be.a('string');
pm.expect(obj.id, 'Resource id must be a valid 24-character hex MongoDB ObjectID').to.match(/^[a-fA-F0-9]{24}$/);

request.description: Verify the customer OTP and capture either onboarding or session JWTs for downstream collections.

exec: pm.test('response uses the standard envelope', function () {
if (obj && typeof obj === 'object' && obj.id !== undefined && obj.id !== null) {
pm.expect(obj.id, 'Resource id must be a string').to.be.a('string');
pm.expect(obj.id, 'Resource id must be a valid 24-character hex MongoDB ObjectID').to.match(/^[a-fA-F0-9]{24}$/);
pm.test('onboarding token has expiresIn of 86400s', function () { pm.expect(data.onboardingExpiresIn).to.equal(86400); });
pm.test('expiresIn is a positive number', function () { pm.expect(data.expiresIn).to.be.a('number').and.to.be.above(0); });
if (data.refreshToken) { pm.test('refreshExpiresIn is a positive number', function () { pm.expect(data.refreshExpiresIn).to.be.a('number').and.to.be.above(0); }); }

exec: pm.test('response uses the standard envelope', function () {
